Description Description Create rendered world maps with a rectangular 3D terrain model in C4D, FBX and OBJ formats. The map uses a geographic projection and includes a TIF satellite texture. A world map with raised terrain The rectangular layout shows terrain across the world on a map surface. Open the model in your 3D software to compose an overview or choose an angled camera view for map illustrations, presentation graphics and animated scenes. Included formats and satellite texture The C4D, FBX and OBJ files are supplied with UV mapping and a 21600 x 10800 px TIF satellite texture. The mesh has an open base. Before 3D printing or CNC machining, check and prepare the geometry for your intended workflow. Choosing between the World models This product combines the terrain model and satellite texture in a C4D/FBX/OBJ package. For a bundle with height, normal and water maps, compare the separate World Earth Map 3D Model linked below. In addition to the 3D terrain model of the World, I can attach a map of heights and various satellite textures. World Map DEM The elevation map is used to get information about low and high parts of the World relief. Satellite image of World The satellite texture is high resolution in TIF format.
